address: Kuşçuburun Mahallesi, Başmimar Sinan Caddesi No:81, Yazıbaşı, Torbalı, Izmir, 35860, Türkiye
bio: The Domaine Lucien Arkas vineyards are well worth a visit. Take some time to stroll among the vines – highly romantic if you have that special someone by your side. The same romantic feeling prevails whether you dine outdoors overlooking the vineyard or indoors with a view of the wine cellar beneath you (bottles are for sale at the entrance). The chef tempts you with unfussy Mediterranean dishes that perfectly complement the quality wines produced here. Charcoal-grilled leg of lamb with a bold lamb jus enriched with mustard, then a wonderfully sweet strawberry magnolia for dessert – honest flavours are paramount, both in the glass and on the plate.
